items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you mentioned Stan Levey some time ago; yes he was very good too.

ctx.x: I don’t know if it was Al Hagert, Duke Jordan, you know. It was one of those groups.
Maybe Stan Levey? I don’t know. Stan was with him at that time.
No, no. It was probably Max.
